title: DECISION: Capability::try_from for IMAP4rev2 pending upstream typed variant
description: imap-types 2.0.0-alpha.6 does not yet expose a typed Capability::Imap4Rev2 variant. Rather than forking the crate or embedding raw bytes, the code uses Capability::try_from("IMAP4rev2") with a .expect() that encodes the invariant: IMAP4rev2 is a valid IMAP atom and the conversion cannot fail at runtime. This is the least-invasive forward-compatible workaround — when the upstream crate eventually adds a typed variant, the call sites are obvious and the migration is mechanical. Alternative rejected: using Capability::Other with an unvalidated string would bypass the library's atom validation and produce a harder-to-find regression if the string ever drifted.
